text:
Iris: Anyone up for a speedrun watch party + couch co-op after hours Friday? Thinking 7pm in the rec room. I'll queue a few GDQ highlight runs and we can follow with Mario Party chaos. :popcorn: :tv:

Mateo: love it. will bring projector if people want big-screen. also can bring a switch + Mario Party cartridge.

Sofia: i'll bring a tray of homemade empanadas (labeled). also down for speedruns, especially platformers. :heart_eyes:

Devon: I can set up a low-latency stream for remote folks via Discord Go Live or Steam Remote Play. Remote devs welcome.

Iris: plan is low-key: watch ~30min speedrun blocks, then local games. rough playlist below:
```
- Super Mario Bros. Any% (classic run)
- Celeste low% highlight
- Hollow Knight all-bosses clip
- Short GDQ montage (10m)
```

Mateo: projector + HDMI confirmed. ops-bot, can we reserve Rec Room from 6:30-10pm?

ops-bot: Reservation request received. To confirm, please choose room setup: "Projector" or "TV+HDMI".

Iris: Projector please. Also is there a DHCP weirdness with guest Wi-Fi for streaming?

Devon: Guest Wi-Fi isolates devices; I'll bring a travel router to bridge for Remote Play.

Sofia: quick poll: who can bring controllers? Reply with the controller type (Switch/PS/Xbox/PC).

Mateo: Switch

Devon: Xbox + wireless dongle

Sofia: PS4 pad

Iris: 2x generic USB controllers

kudos-bot: Shoutout to @Sofia for volunteering snacks! :tada:

Iris: sweet. Final note: no scoreboard stress, just memes and chill. Remote folks, we'll drop the invite link here Friday. See y'all for speedrun popcorn and chaotic party-mode Mario. :joystick:
